content.value: A set of beams each containing 32,000 yds of warp is to be used for producing of 10 weavers beams on a high speed slasher. If % of elongation is ½ % and wastage of warp is 60 yds. Calculate the number of beams. The length of sized warp on a weaver is 1200 yds.
